CustomField.formula: IF(TC_Expiration_Date__c < TODAY(), "Expired", IF(TC_Expiration_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), 6), "0-6 Months", IF(TC_Expiration_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), 12), "6-12 Months", IF(TC_Expiration_Date__c <= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), 24), "12-24 Months", "24+ Months"))))
CustomField.label: Expiration Bucket
